scope.research_purpose: Build and maintain an evidence-governed global NeuroAI landscape that identifies and characterizes relevant technologies, actors, products and commercialization pathways; distinguishes conventional clinical/scientific activity from harder-to-identify nonclinical applications; maps observed capabilities to bounded governance concerns; and routes only exact systems with sufficient evidence toward v4.2 assessment or reopening review.
non_goals: Claim a complete census of every NeuroAI company or product in an open-world discovery setting
Equate patent ownership with implementation or commercialization
Equate company marketing with independent effectiveness or regulatory authorization
Use model consensus as ground truth
Infer company intent or future harm
scope.protocol_bounded_saturation_semantics: For open-world company, product, gray-third and multilingual discovery, saturation is only a property of the declared seeds, channels, rounds, languages, jurisdictions and stopping rule. It never establishes global completeness.

questions.text: What identifiable NeuroAI technologies and capabilities are being developed, and how are they changing over time?
questions.rationale: Defines the technology/capability landscape and its temporal change.

questions.text: Which organizations own, develop, finance, supply, commercialize or deploy those capabilities, and where are they located?
questions.rationale: Separates actor roles and geography instead of collapsing organizations into a single company count.

questions.text: Which technologies have moved from research or patenting into identifiable products, services or deployments?
questions.rationale: Tests commercialization and deployment transition using evidence distinct from patent ownership or marketing.

questions.text: Which commercially relevant applications are missed when identification begins from conventional clinical/scientific neurotechnology terminology?
questions.rationale: Makes the nonclinical and nontraditional gray-third recall problem an explicit research object.

questions.text: How concentrated are relevant patents, companies, product classes and capabilities by actor, jurisdiction and application context?
questions.rationale: Supports concentration analysis only after inclusion, identity and denominator boundaries are established.

questions.text: Which existing governance concerns are implicated by capabilities already observable in real products or deployment contexts?
questions.rationale: Constrains governance analysis to observed capability/context mechanisms instead of predicted company behavior.

questions.text: Which exact systems merit deeper evidence-bounded v4.2 assessment or reopening of an existing assessment dependency?
questions.rationale: Keeps landscape salience separate from exact-system assessment authority.

secondary_questions.text: How much incremental recall comes from capability-first gray-third discovery compared with conventional clinical/scientific terminology?
How does marginal new-entity yield change by open-world discovery round and channel, and where does the declared protocol stop?
How do classifier error, calibration, abstention and false-negative classes vary by language, jurisdiction and missing-text condition?
How does patent-product link error vary by L1-L4 evidence tier?
Which substantive conclusions change when prioritized non-English discovery is added to English-only discovery?
Which inclusion, ontology, concordance or governance-mapping boundary cases remain disputed after structured expert review?

claim_classes.maximum_interpretation: An organization, product, system or patent-related object was observed in the stated source and observation context.
The scoped source supports the stated capability or deployment-context description for the exact observed product or system.
The exact organization has the stated evidenced role, such as owner, developer, funder, supplier, commercializer or deployer, within the stated scope and time.
prohibited_inferences: Parent and subsidiary identities are interchangeable
Current role from historical evidence alone

claim_classes.maximum_interpretation: Evidence supports the stated research, product, service or deployment state for the exact scoped object and time.
Evidence supports an INCLUDE, EXCLUDE, BORDERLINE or ABSTAIN disposition under the exact research-contract boundary.
The reported concentration statistic applies only to the stated validated inclusion set, denominator, jurisdiction, time and discovery universe.
prohibited_inferences: Global market share from an open-world protocol

claim_classes.maximum_interpretation: The product-patent relation is reported at its explicit L1-L4 evidence tier and only for the tier-permitted use.
prohibited_inferences: Ownership certainty from shared names alone

claim_classes.maximum_interpretation: An observed capability in an evidenced context could implicate the stated governance concern under stated conditions through the stated mechanism.
The exact system is recommended for evidence-bounded v4.2 assessment or dependency reopening; the trigger itself has no assessment effect.
prohibited_inferences: Assessment finding from landscape salience alone

claim_classes.maximum_interpretation: A reproducible evaluation design exists with the required held-out, subgroup, uncertainty and anti-leakage controls.

evidence_rules.ATTRIBUTABLE_PUBLIC_SOURCE: Public source with attributable provenance and a reviewable source/observation identity.
evidence_rules.TRACEABLE_LICENSED_SOURCE: Licensed or otherwise constrained source used only within its permitted purpose, access and redistribution boundary.
evidence_rules.MULTI_SIGNAL_ATTRIBUTABLE_EVIDENCE: At least two attributable evidence elements jointly support the bounded claim, while disagreement and alternatives remain explicit.
evidence_rules.EXPERT_REVIEW_REQUIRED: Attributable human domain review is required before the governed disposition or mapping is treated as accepted.
evidence_rules.VALIDATED_ANALYTICAL_DENOMINATOR: The statistic is computed over an explicitly declared and validated denominator or controlled discovery universe.
evidence_rules.PATENT_PRODUCT_TIERED_EVIDENCE: The relation uses the controlled L1-L4 patent-product evidence scheme and preserves the tier in every downstream use.
evidence_rules.MECHANISM_BOUNDED_GOVERNANCE_MAPPING: The mapping follows observed capability plus deployment context to mechanism to concern to policy instrument, with bounded language and no predicted-harm claim.
evidence_rules.EXACT_SYSTEM_TRIGGER_EVIDENCE: The trigger binds an exact system/configuration and evidence sufficient to justify review for v4.2 assessment or dependency reopening, without altering assessment state.
evidence_rules.DOCUMENTED_EVALUATION_PROTOCOL: A reproducible evaluation protocol exists with held-out human labels, declared metrics, threshold logic, subgroup analysis, abstention and leakage controls.

gray_third.operational_rule: Gray-third is a capability-first discovery and boundary-validation stratum for commercially relevant or nontraditional applications that conventional clinical/scientific neurotechnology terminology may miss. A gray-third hit remains a candidate and requires the same INCLUDE/EXCLUDE/BORDERLINE/ABSTAIN adjudication as any other candidate.

required_outputs: candidate publications with exact provider identifiers

tiers.meaning: Product/company documentation or an authoritative record explicitly binds the exact product to the patent, application or family.
tiers.permitted_use: Direct linkage within the exact stated scope.

tiers.meaning: The patent is attributable to the company or controlled entity and strong technical plus timing evidence matches the product capability.
tiers.permitted_use: Qualified inferred link; the inference label must be retained.

tiers.meaning: Multiple independent signals align without an explicit binding.
tiers.permitted_use: Exploratory or qualitative use; quantitative use only after a validated link-error study.
Discovery and ranking only; never an established product-patent relationship or commercialized-patent count.

roles.permitted: Generate search variants, multilingual terminology and ranking signals.
Extract structured fields from captured sources with source locations.
roles.prohibited: Replace the source or invent missing fields.

roles.permitted: Score relevance, capability, context or candidate link class.
Explain disagreement and prioritize cases for review.
roles.prohibited: Become the final governed adjudicator by model consensus.
Assert future harmful behavior or unsupported normative conclusions.

roles.permitted: Draft bounded summaries from accepted structured evidence.
roles.prohibited: Add unsupported claims to publication artifacts.

governance_mapping.bounded_language_template: could implicate concern {concern} under conditions {conditions} through mechanism {mechanism}

gate_acceptance.condition: Human-adjudicated positive, negative and borderline patent/product cases are frozen with provenance; the held-out test split is inaccessible to tuning workflows; hashes are recorded.
Structured-source projectors produce reproducible candidate/coverage outputs while preserving exact identity, paging/denominator, minimization and candidate-only semantics.
Open-world pilot records discovery lineage, source/channel coverage, marginal yield, identity/dedupe decisions and failure taxonomy without claiming global completeness.
Predeclared precision, recall, calibration, abstention, disagreement and subgroup criteria are met, or the automated role is explicitly narrowed.

stopping_change_control.open_world_stopping_basis: Predeclared round/channel budgets plus marginal new-entity yield and failure-state accounting under the exact declared protocol.

authority_boundary: This PRE-G1 contract freezes research structure, evidence and evaluation semantics for review. It cannot approve G0 or G1, establish substantive scientific truth by technical validation, authorize publication, mutate canonical S2, pass G2-G12, alter v4.2 assessment state, or substitute model output for attributable human governance.
